title: EPILOGUE // WINGED GODS
narrative: Bran slips his consciousness beneath the golden-cream scales of Viserion. Dragon and greenseer merge into an all-seeing immortal guardian circling the clouds above Westeros. Kings and queens will rise and fall, but the dragon-seer watches over the realm forever from the sky.
